summary:
E2E validation of NivXRay v1.3.x (Feb-2026): decode/smart response shape (top-level chain_ids/score/risk), multi-fragment
-split, reverse-string chain, AMSI T1562.001 heuristic, 6 MITRE gap-fix heuristics (verified via existing unit tests + AMSI via API), Lab narrative endpoint (rubric 40/30/30 + Claude grading + enriched MITRE), /api/lab/reveal enrichment, /api/mitre/heatmap, /api/corpus/validate/json, /api/threat-intel/feeds/sync, /api/batch/test/json + /api/batch/history. UI: /lab (3 textareas, submit, rubric bars, Claude feedback, strengths/gaps, MITRE chips with names), /heatmap (289 heuristics · 125 techniques matrix rendered), /batch-test (input, run btn, history), /workspace (multi-fragment engine + rundll32/lsass output visible). 11/11 new e2e pytest cases pass.

issues: Task expected label 'Recent Runs' — actual button label is 'HISTORY (30)'. Functionally equivalent (opens history/runs list). Cosmetic label divergence only.

backend_endpoints.POST /api/lab/attempt/narrative: 200 · rubric caps enforced (40/30/30), sum==score, max_score=100, provider=emergent-claude, expected_mitre_enriched list of {id,name,tactic}
backend_endpoints.GET /api/mitre/heatmap: 200 · total_heuristics=289, unique_techniques=125, tactics list, matrix dict, top_techniques list

frontend_flows./lab narrative UI: 3 textareas (understanding/impact/recommendations), submit btn, rubric hint '/40 · /30 · /30 · perfect ≥ 85' present. After submit: rubric bars (lab-rubric-understanding/impact/recommendations), lab-ai-feedback, lab-mitre-reveal, strengths + gaps split, MITRE chip shows 'T1070.004 · File Deletion' (T-ID + human name).
frontend_flows./lab HUD + leaderboard: Streak, Best, Total XP, Perfect stats + leaderboard table with admin@nivxray.com row rendered
frontend_flows./heatmap page: Loaded — 289 heuristics · 125 techniques across 13 tactics, matrix cells, top-covered chips, sparse-tactic warning all render without errors
frontend_flows./batch-test page: Loaded with textarea, mode select, 'RUN 5 PAYLOADS', 'DOWNLOAD RESULTS AS CSV', 'UPLOAD .CSV / .JSON', 'DOWNLOAD EXAMPLE CSV', 'HISTORY (30)', 'RUN NXGEC GOLD CORPUS' controls
frontend_flows./workspace multi-fragment paste: Status shows 'NIVXRAY DECODE COMPLETE · multi-fragment · 65%'; recipe shows extract-payload → Base64 Decode → UTF-16LE Decode chain; rundll32/comsvcs/lsass surface in decoded output

action_items: OPTIONAL cosmetic: rename batch-test 'HISTORY (30)' button to 'RECENT RUNS' to match spec wording (or vice-versa in spec).

OPTIONAL: on /batch-test add a data-testid on the payload textarea / run button (currently none found under expected names batch-test-payloads/batch-test-run-btn). Playwright fell back to visible text — works but less robust.
OPTIONAL cleanup carried over from iter_13/14: WorkspacePage.jsx ~L1005 <span data-ve-dynamic> nested inside <option> hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: review_request lists route paths that don't match implementation: `/api/heatmap/data` → actual `/api/mitre/heatmap`; `/api/batch/runs` → actual `/api/batch/history`; `/api/corpus/validate` (POST JSON) → actual `/api/corpus/validate/json` (the plain path requires multipart file upload). Consumers relying on the review-request paths would get 404/422. Consider adding lightweight alias routes or updating docs.
mitre_heatmap._default_tactic falls back to 'Defense Evasion' for unknown T-IDs — may inflate that tactic's coverage in the matrix. Log a warning or attribute to 'Unknown' bucket instead.
seed_data_creation: Test created 1 lab_attempts row (narrative grading) + 1 batch_history row (2-payload batch) + threat-intel feed sync ran once. All bounded, safe.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All v1.3.x features work end-to-end. Actual route paths differ from what review_request v1.3.x doc claimed — see critical_code_review_comments. Regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_v13x_e2e.py (11 tests, ~15s parallel).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs. Only actionable finding is a routing docs/spec mismatch (paths listed in review_request don't match implementation; endpoints themselves are healthy).
